newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD TO MEET WREXHAM IN QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHESTERFIELD TO MEET WREXHAM IN QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Either Chesterfield or Wrexham will reach the semifinals of the English F.A. Cup for the first time in their histories after the two second division sides were drawn to play against each other in the quarter-finals on Sunday.

Chesterfield, who stunned premier league Nottingham Forest 1-0 in the fifth round on Saturday to reach the quarter-finals for the first time, will be at home again against the Welsh side who knocked out first division Birmingham City 3-1 on Saturday.

It will be the second time in successive seasons they have clashed in the cup after meeting each other in a second round tie last season which Wrexham won 3-2 in the more familiar surroundings of the second round.

Only six teams from what is effectively the third tier of English soccer have ever reached the last four before, the last being Plymouth Argyle in 1984. No team from that level has ever reached the final.

The one other clearcut tie pits premier league Sheffield Wednesday against Wimbledon, who knocked out last year's winners Manchester United in the fourth round and followed that up with a fifth round win over Queens Park Rangers on Saturday.

First division Portsmouth, who reached the semifinals in 1992, will play the winners of the Chelsea-Leicester replay and Middlesbrough, who have never gone beyond the sixth round in their 121-year history, will play the winner of the delayed fifth round tie between Coventry City and Derby County.
Bookmakers William Hill and Ladbrokes both make Chelsea favourites to win the cup, even though they lost a 2-0 lead to draw 2-2 at Leicester on Sunday.

Hills make Chelsea 2-1 favourites, while Ladbrokes price them at 9-4. Wimbledon are second favourites at 7-2 (Hills), 4-1 (Ladbrokes). Chesterfield are quoted at 25-1 by Hills, with Wrexham the outsiders at 33-1.
The matches will be played on the weekend of March 8-9.
